arxiv-1508-00562.title: DESY 15-127
arxiv-1508-00562.creator: MPP-2015-157
arxiv-1508-00562.description: Abstract We describe the implementation of the two-loop Higgs-mass corrections of 𝒪 ⁡ ( α t 2 ) \mathcal{O}(\alpha_{t}^{2}) in the complex MSSM in FeynHiggs . The program for the calculation is comprised of several scripts which flexibly use FeynArts and FormCalc together with other packages.

arxiv-2011-08630.title: BH Mass, Jet and Accretion Disk Connection: An Analysis of Radio-loud and Radio-quiet Quasars Publication type: Article Type
arxiv-2011-08630.creator: Avinanda Chakraborty*, Anirban Bhattacharjee**
arxiv-2011-08630.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Avinanda Chakraborty*, Anirban Bhattacharjee**. Surveys have shown radio-loud (RL) quasars constitute 10 % 10\% - 15 % 15\% of the total quasar population. However, it is unknown if the radio-loud fraction (RL quasars/Total quasars) remains consistent among different parameter spaces. This study shows that radio-loud fraction increases for increasing full width half maximum (FWHM) velocity of the H β \beta and MgII broad emission line. Our data has been obtained from [ 26 ] catalogue.

arxiv-2102-04411.title: Traceability Transformed: Generating more Accurate Links with Pre-Trained BERT Models
arxiv-2102-04411.creator: Jinfeng Lin, Yalin Liu, Qingkai Zeng, Meng Jiang, Jane Cleland-Huang
arxiv-2102-04411.description: Abstract Software traceability establishes and leverages associations between diverse development artifacts. Researchers have proposed the use of deep learning trace models to link natural language artifacts, such as requirements and issue descriptions, to source code; however, their effectiveness has been restricted by availability of labeled data and efficiency at runtime.

arxiv-2107-07266.title: Neural Architecture Search using Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy
arxiv-2107-07266.creator: Nilotpal Sinha, Kuan-Wen Chen
arxiv-2107-07266.description: Abstract Evolution-based neural architecture search requires high computational resources, resulting in long search time. In this work, we propose a framework of applying the Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (CMA-ES) to the neural architecture search problem called CMANAS, which achieves better results than previous evolution-based methods while reducing the search time significantly.

arxiv-2108-06929.title: On the framework of L p L_{p} summations for functions Thanks: The first named author was supported in part by the Zuckerman STEM Leadership program
arxiv-2108-06929.creator: Michael Roysdon and Sudan Xing
arxiv-2108-06929.description: Abstract . We develop the framework of L p L_{p} operations for functions by introducing two primary new types L p , s L_{p,s} summations for p > 0 p>0 : the L p , s L_{p,s} convolution sum and the L p , s L_{p,s} Asplund sum for functions.

arxiv-2202-11546.title: Impact of QCD uncertainties on antiproton spectra from dark-matter annihilation
arxiv-2202-11546.creator: and Peter Skands
arxiv-2202-11546.description: Abstract Dark-matter particles that annihilate or decay can undergo complex sequences of processes, including strong and electromagnetic radiation, hadronisation, and hadron decays, before particles that are stable on astrophysical time scales are produced. Antiprotons produced in this way may leave footprints in experiments such as AMS–02.

arxiv-2302-07287.title: Forward Pass: On the Security Implications of Email Forwarding Mechanism and Policy
arxiv-2302-07287.creator: Enze Liu, Gautam Akiwate, Mattijs Jonker, Ariana Mirian, Grant Ho, Geoffrey M. Voelker, Stefan Savage
arxiv-2302-07287.description: Abstract The critical role played by email has led to a range of extension protocols (e.g., SPF, DKIM, DMARC) designed to protect against the spoofing of email sender domains. These protocols are complex as is, but are further complicated by automated email forwarding — used by individual users to manage multiple accounts and by mailing lists to redistribute messages.

arxiv-2308-13569.title: Discovering Mental Health Research Topics with Topic Modeling
arxiv-2308-13569.creator: Xin Gao, Cem Sazara
arxiv-2308-13569.description: Abstract Mental health significantly influences various aspects of our daily lives, and its importance has been increasingly recognized by the research community and the general public, particularly in the wake of the COVID-19 pandemic. This heightened interest is evident in the growing number of publications dedicated to mental health in the past decade.

arxiv-2402-14411.title: J-UniMorph : Japanese Morphological Annotation through the Universal Feature Schema
arxiv-2402-14411.creator: Kosuke Matsuzaki ♣, Masaya Taniguchi ♡, Kentaro Inui ♢ ♣ ♡, Keisuke Sakaguchi ♣ ♡, ♡ RIKEN, ♢ MBZUAI
arxiv-2402-14411.description: Abstract We introduce a Japanese Morphology dataset, J-UniMorph , developed based on the UniMorph feature schema. This dataset addresses the unique and rich verb forms characteristic of the language’s agglutinative nature. J-UniMorph distinguishes itself from the existing Japanese subset of UniMorph, which is automatically extracted from Wiktionary.

arxiv-2403-02651.title: Learning at the Speed of Wireless: Online Real-Time Learning for AI-Enabled MIMO in NextG
arxiv-2403-02651.creator: Jiarui Xu, Shashank Jere, Yifei Song, Yi-Hung Kao, Lizhong Zheng, Lingjia Liu
arxiv-2403-02651.description: Abstract Integration of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) into the air interface has been envisioned as a key technology for next-generation (NextG) cellular networks. At the air interface, multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) and its variants such as multi-user MIMO (MU-MIMO) and massive/full-dimension MIMO have been key enablers across successive generations of cellular networks with evolving complexity and design challenges.

arxiv-2409-04923.title: Single-snapshot machine learning for super-resolution of turbulence
arxiv-2409-04923.creator: Kai Fukami *, Kunihiko Taira
arxiv-2409-04923.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Kai Fukami *, Kunihiko Taira. Modern machine-learning techniques are generally considered data-hungry. However, this may not be the case for turbulence as each of its snapshots can hold more information than a single data file in general machine-learning settings. This study asks the question of whether nonlinear machine-learning techniques can effectively extract physical insights even from as little as a single snapshot of turbulent flow.

arxiv-2508-05090.title: Cold Start Active Preference Learning in Socio-Economic Domains
arxiv-2508-05090.creator: Mojtaba Fayazbakhsh 1 , Danial Ataee 2 , MohammadAmin Fazli 1
arxiv-2508-05090.description: Abstract Active preference learning is a powerful paradigm for efficiently modeling preferences, yet it suffers from the cold-start problem: a significant drop in performance when no initial labeled data is available. This challenge is particularly acute in computational social systems and economic analysis, where labeled data is often scarce, expensive, and subject to expert noise.

arxiv-2509-15111.title: QMUL-PH-25-26 Tension between string amplitude prescriptions with presumed spacetime supersymmetry
arxiv-2509-15111.creator: Thales Azevedo, Alessandro Georgoudis, Renann Lipinski Jusinskas, Sitender Pratap Kashyap
arxiv-2509-15111.description: Abstract We analyze an alternative prescription for computing tree level scattering amplitudes in the pure spinor superstring. Proposed by Berkovits, and inspired by an earlier work by Lee and Siegel, it bypasses the traditional ghost number three measure of the pure spinor ghosts, ⟨ λ 3 ​ θ 5 ⟩ \langle\lambda^{3}\theta^{5}\rangle =1, arguably simplifying the calculation.

arxiv-2605-13190.title: N-vium: Mixture-of-Exits Transformer for Accelerated Exact Generation

arxiv-2605-29483.creator: Di Zhu, Yu Yvonne Wu, Hong Jia, Aaqib Saeed, Vassilis Kostakos, Ting Dang

pmc-11296845.title: NIRL-09 PERI-AMPULLARY CARCINOMA METASTASIS TO THE BRAIN: A RARE CASE REPORT FROM INDIA
pmc-11296845.creator: Arushi Sangwan, Saurabh Mishra, Shaleen Rana
pmc-11296845.description: Peri-ampullary carcinoma refers to a group of neoplasms arising from the head of the pancreas, the distal common bile duct (CBD), and the duodenum. It is typically associated with metastases to intra-abdominal sites, distant lymph nodes, lungs, and bone. Metastasis of peri-ampullary carcinoma involving the brain is extremely rare, with less than five reported cases in current literature.

pmc-11316998.title: Propolis supplementation can reduce serum level of interleukin-6, C-reactive protein, and tumor necrosis factor-α: an updated systematic review and dose-response meta-analysis on randomized clinical trials
pmc-11316998.creator: Ali Gholami, Negar Dinarvand, Mitra Hariri
pmc-11316998.description: BackgroundNew evidence suggested that propolis might reduce serum levels of inflammatory mediators; therefore, in this study we aimed to prove the potential effect of propolis on serum levels of interleukin-6 (IL-6), C-reactive protein (CRP), and tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-α) through conducting a systematic review and meta-analysis.MethodsDatabases including PubMed, ClinicalTrials.

pmc-11442521.title: Radiographic identification of symptomless mandibular third molars without clinical pericoronitis
pmc-11442521.creator: Tommi Vesala, Irja Ventä, Johanna Snäll, Marja Ekholm
pmc-11442521.description: ObjectivesThe aim was to identify radiographic characteristics of mandibular third molars in young adults without symptoms or clinical signs of pericoronal infection.Materials and methodsAn existing cross-sectional material, including records from clinical oral examination and panoramic radiographs (PANs) of university students, was submitted to retrospective analysis. The outcome variable was a symptomless and clinically pericoronitis-free mandibular third molar.

pmc-12417986.title: Nurse-led treatment engagement interventions for persons with severe mental illnesses in community settings
pmc-12417986.creator: Revathi Somanathan, Sailaxmi Gandhi, T Sivakumar, Narayana Manjunatha
pmc-12417986.description: This review aims to gain a deeper understanding of the current interventions used in high-income and low- and middle-income countries worldwide on treatment engagement among persons with severe mental illnesses. Treatment engagement involves cultivating therapeutic partnerships to address patients’ unique needs and challenges. This multifaceted process requires sensitivity, collaboration, and a tailored approach to promote positive outcomes.

pmc-12473067.title: Effect of Hypothyroidism on the Risk of Carpal Tunnel Syndrome and Electrodiagnostic Parameters
pmc-12473067.creator: Ahmad R. Abuzinadah
pmc-12473067.description: Background: Hypothyroidism has been implicated as a risk factor for carpal tunnel syndrome (CTS). However, the effect of hypothyroidism on the risk of CTS has not been studied in large, non-selective clinic populations, and the impact of hypothyroidism on electrodiagnostic parameters remains inadequately understood. Methods: In this retrospective study, we examined 480 patients referred for upper limb electrodiagnostic evaluation.

pmc-12511594.title: Triglyceride-glucose index predicts the mortality risk among incident peritoneal dialysis patients in a cohort study
pmc-12511594.creator: Kao-Ming Hsu, Yao-Peng Hsieh, Yu-Jun Chang, Shr-Mei Tsai, Ping-Fang Chiu
pmc-12511594.description: Insulin resistance (IR) frequently cause higher levels of fasting glucose and triglyceride. Triglyceride- glucose (TyG) index has been suggested as a simple, reliable, and cost-effective surrogate for IR. We conducted the present study to assess whether TyG index is associated with increased risk of all-cause and cardiovascular (CV) mortality among our PD cohort.

pmc-12663631.title: SCAD: A modular platform for efficient delivery of duplex RNA to the CNS and beyond
pmc-12663631.creator: Moorim Kang, Wei-Hsiang Lin, Yichen Li, Feifei Xu, Xiaojie Zhou, Chunyan Si, Jianxiu Dai, Jichao He, Ian Schacht, Zubao Gan, Vera Huang, Long-Cheng Li
pmc-12663631.description: Oligonucleotide therapeutics—including antisense oligonucleotides and duplex RNAs such as small interfering RNAs, small activating RNAs, and microRNAs—hold immense potential for treating both genetic and acquired diseases by modulating gene expression in a target-specific manner. However, effective delivery to extrahepatic tissues, particularly the central nervous system, remains a significant challenge.

pmc-13145594.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A1288 DETECTION OF CARDIAC SOURCES OF EMBOLI USING CARDIAC CT ANGIOGRAPHY IN HYPERACUTE STROKE IMAGING: A SINGLE-CENTRE RETROSPECTIVE COHORT STUDY OF REAL-WORLD EXPERIENCE
pmc-13145594.creator: Abdullah Al Subhi, Jack Lott, Dominique Dabreo, Gurmohan Rob Dhillon, Shirin Jalini
pmc-13145594.description: Background and aimsCardiac CT angiography (cCTA) is an emerging alternative imaging modality to examine cardiac structures during hyperacute stroke. Our centre is the first in Canada to incorporate cCTA (non-ECG-gated study) into routine clinical care. We aimed to measure its detection rate of cardiac sources of emboli, and its effects on management in this real-world population.

pmc-13147206.title: Schistosomiasis Knowledge, Attitudes, and Practices Among School‐Going Children Aged 5–14 Years in Nelson Mandela Bay (NMB), South Africa
pmc-13147206.creator: Maryline Vere, Wilma ten Ham-Baloyi, Lucy Ochola, Opeoluwa Oyedele, Takafira Mduluza, Paula Melariri, Satabdi Datta Choudhury
pmc-13147206.description: BackgroundSchistosomiasis, a parasitic waterborne infection, remains a major public health challenge in disadvantaged regions, with schoolchildren (5–14 years) at high risk due to frequent water exposure. The study is aimed at assessing the knowledge, attitudes, and practices (KAP) related to schistosomiasis among school‐aged children in Nelson Mandela Bay (NMB) and examining how sociodemographic and environmental factors influence KAP outcomes.

pmc-13217031.title: School readiness in children with early-onset chronic liver disease: a population-based linked data cohort in England
pmc-13217031.creator: Nicolás R Libuy, Marianne Samyn, Katie L Harron
pmc-13217031.description: BackgroundChronic liver disease (CLD) affects 2–10 per 10 000 children. While prior evidence links CLD to lower cognitive ability, its impact on school readiness remains unclear.ObjectiveTo study the association between early-onset chronic liver disease (CLD; <5 years) and school readiness at age 5.

pmc-13254863.title: Effect of Orthopedic Resident Surgical Education on Surgical Case Length and Healthcare Costs
pmc-13254863.creator: Robert W. Gomez, Kevin G. Valdes, Kristofer S. Matullo
pmc-13254863.description: PurposeThe study investigates the impact of resident involvement in orthopedic hand surgery, focusing on operative and room times, as well as the associated opportunity costs to physicians and the hospital. The primary objective was to examine the impact of resident participation on operative times and total surgical room times in comparison to attending-only procedures.

pmc-13325446.title: Real Time Pulse Chase (RTPC) In-Cell NMR Spectroscopy Reveals Critical Metabolites in Subminute Metabolism of Undifferentiated and Differentiated Human Neuronal Cells
pmc-13325446.creator: Spoorthy Sandras, Nicholas Sciolino, Sergey Reverdatto, David S. Burz, Jayanti Pande, Ann Marie Schmidt, Ravichandran Ramasamy, Alexander Shekhtman

pmc-13385714.title: Hybrid IGWO-Dingo optimized DeMoHybridNet model for multi-class leaf disease identification
pmc-13385714.creator: Shantilata Palei, Puspanjali Mohapatra, Soubhagya Ranjan Mallick, Princy Diwan
pmc-13385714.description: To achieve efficient crop management, exact plant disease detection in leaves is required. This study proposes DeMoHybridNet (Bottleneck Reduction Fusion) for the automated classification of Corn, Apple, Citrus, and Mango crop diseases. Input images are processed through augmentation and resizing, and then features are learned using DenseNet-201 and MobileNetV2. Global Average Pooling is applied, which produces condensed features.
